title: mut.channel_casey_reas
mutation_directive: Channel Casey Reas (Process compendium / Software Structures). Strip color saturation entirely — output must be near-monochrome (single dominant hue 0.0-0.15 saturation) with ONE small accent color used sparingly. Replace any noise with a deterministic rule-based emergence (cellular automaton, agent-based steering with simple local rules, or Reas's 'process 11' style — agents leaving traces). Embrace stillness and restraint. No sparkle, no glow excess. The form should feel like generative art from 2010, not 2025.

refik_anadol.praise: The deterministic rule-based emergence is honest — no Perlin crutch, no glow mask. The seek/trace state machine produces genuinely emergent vertical structure from 280 agents, and the near-monochrome palette with desaturated rust accent shows real discipline.
refik_anadol.concern: 280 agents producing a fist-sized knot in the center of an enormous black canvas is the opposite of architectural scale. The form doesn't command the frame — it floats as a timid sketch. At this count the trace accumulation reads as scribble, not structure. The piece says 'vertical' in its title but the thumbnail reads as a compressed horizontal lozenge.
refik_anadol.directive: 10x the agent count to 2800+, spread the initial disc wider, and let traces fill at least 60% of the viewport height.

sasha_stiles.praise: The restraint is genuine — no sparkle, no glow, near-monochrome with a single rust accent used at 5% frequency. This is honest to the Reas directive. The deterministic RNG seeding means the piece writes the same sentence every time, which gives it a kind of calligraphic integrity.
sasha_stiles.concern: The line segments have no breath, no spacing, no rhythm of mark-and-void. Every trace is the same opacity (0.5), the same weight, the same pace. In Reas's actual Process work, the traces accumulate legibly — you can read the history of each agent's passage like a line of handwriting. Here the lines collapse into an undifferentiated mass where no single agent's journey is recoverable.
sasha_stiles.directive: Vary trace opacity by agent age so early marks fade and recent ones read — let the viewer parse individual trajectories.

entangled_others.praise: The seek-then-trace state transition — agents independently switching behavior when local density crosses a threshold — is genuinely emergent, not parametric. This is closer to slime mold physarum aggregation than most generative art admits: local sensing, no global coordinator, collective structure from individual rules.
entangled_others.concern: The piece is ecologically sterile. All 280 agents obey identical rules, identical parameters, identical color. In any real biological system — even a monoculture — there's phenotypic variation: some agents would be faster seekers, some would trace longer spirals, some would fail to transition. The uniform behavior produces a uniform blob. There's no niche differentiation, no competition, no symbiosis.
entangled_others.directive: Introduce 3-4 agent phenotypes with different climb speeds, trace durations, and spiral radii so the structure self-differentiates.

olafur_eliasson.praise: Antialiasing is off, the palette is atmospheric not decorative, and the slow camera orbit means the viewer's perspective constantly shifts — the piece is never the same twice from any angle. The dark field surrounding the trace structure creates a genuine depth/void relationship.
olafur_eliasson.concern: The piece has no light. Not illumination — light as a material presence. The traces are uniformly bright lines on a dark ground, but there's no diffusion, no atmosphere, no sense that the structure exists in a medium. The camera orbits but the viewer is locked outside, observing a specimen. There's no fog, no volumetric haze, no sense of being inside the structure. The 42° FOV and 28-unit camera distance guarantee clinical detachment.
olafur_eliasson.directive: Add a subtle exponential fog matching the background color so distant traces dissolve — this creates atmospheric depth and pulls the viewer in.

chiharu_shiota.praise: These are lines, not points — line segments deposited as traces, accumulating into a three-dimensional web. The seek/trace state machine means each line is earned: the agent had to arrive, sense density, transition, then spiral. There is a logic of necessity behind each thread, not random decoration.
chiharu_shiota.concern: The lines are not taut. Shiota's threads are tensioned between anchor points — they are straight, structural, load-bearing. Here the traces follow curved orbital paths, producing soft arcs and swoops. More critically, there is no anchor object — no suspended bed, no key, no chair at the center. The structure spirals around an empty axis. Without a still, remembered object at its heart, the web has no subject. It is architecture without inhabitant, memory without content.
chiharu_shiota.directive: Add one suspended geometric primitive at the vertical axis center and force trace lines to occasionally anchor to its surface.
